evidence.detail: The constructor writes the exact surviving overlay identity literal 'BossBarOverlay' into the shared positioned-overlay base.

The class extends the positioned client-overlay base, configures overlay placement/layer state and fixed bounds, and renders one boss-bar surface only when its packet-controlled visibility state is enabled.
Its reset method restores progress to 0, bar colors to their exact defaults, both percentage strings to '100%', and auxiliary display strings to empty.

Rendering converts the integer progress field into a 0-100 proportion, draws the fixed 220-pixel bar and proportional foreground width, and renders the packet-fed percentage/display strings over the same surface.
R125 independently fixes rs/l/f/a/c/b as ScriptPacket 7 BossBarOverlayPacketHandler; that handler exclusively creates and mutates this exact rs/l/f/a/c/a instance.

proposals.note: BossBarOverlay is fixed by the exact surviving 'BossBarOverlay' identity literal and a complete single-purpose progress-bar render/reset lifecycle. R125 independently fixes its exclusive ScriptPacket 7 owner. Confidence is 0.999.
